summary: A password field with a show / hide toggle.

pairs.dont: Ship a password field without a way to see what was typed.
pairs.do: Use PasswordInput, which has the eye built in.
pairs.why: Typing blind is the main cause of failed sign-ins and mistyped new passwords. Seeing it once fixes both.

pairs.dont: Leave autocomplete as current-password on a 'choose a password' field.
pairs.why: It is the signal password managers use to offer a strong generated password instead of filling an old one.

pairs.do: Let people reveal what they typed.
pairs.why: Retyping a password twice checks memory, not accuracy. The eye checks accuracy directly.

a11y: The eye is a button with aria-pressed and a label that says what it will do: 'Show password' / 'Hide password'.
Autocorrect, autocapitalise and spellcheck are off, so a revealed password is not 'corrected'.
